content.text:
Here's a full investor deck built from the locked positioning, mechanism, and investor terms currently approved for external use. No traction numbers or entity status beyond what's confirmed, per policy.

```json
[
  {
    "type": "title",
    "title": "Gratitude, delivered.",
    "subtitle": "The Infrastructure for Human Acknowledgment",
    "notes": "Open on the category line and signature. Let it breathe before moving to the problem."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "The problem isn't intention. It's the absence of infrastructure.",
    "body": "People care. Organizations care. Communities care. What's missing is a system that turns that intention into real-world action.",
    "bullets": [
      "60% never or rarely express gratitude to coworkers",
      "74% never or rarely express gratitude to their boss",
      "82% of employees say recognition matters, yet most go years without one",
      "Source: John Templeton Foundation Gratitude Survey (Penn Schoen Berland); SurveyMonkey"
    ],
    "notes": "These are the only approved problem stats. Do not add or estimate additional figures."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "One infrastructure. Multiple ways in. Real-world impact out.",
    "body": "Gratitude.com gives good intention somewhere to go. Acts of good are already funded and ready. A person chooses one and puts it into motion.",
    "bullets": [
      "First platform turning gratitude into measurable impact",
      "Not competing in an existing market. Defining a new one",
      "Most giving ends with a receipt. Gratitude ends with a result"
    ],
    "notes": "This is the category claim. State it plainly, no hedging."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "Fund first. Act instantly. Verify what happened.",
    "body": "Funding makes good possible. Activation makes it personal.",
    "bullets": [
      "Pre-fund: capital is committed before the moment of action",
      "Activate: a person chooses an act and pays nothing, because capacity already exists",
      "Deliver: a trusted nonprofit partner turns activation into real-world good",
      "Verify: delivery is confirmed rather than assumed",
      "Show Impact: the participant sees what happened",
      "Refill: new funding replenishes capacity for the next person"
    ],
    "notes": "This is the core mechanic. Reserve and replenish language beyond this is pending attorney review, do not go further."
  },
  {
    "type": "two-column",
    "title": "Where we are now, and where we're going",
    "left": {
      "heading": "NOW",
      "bullets": [
        "Activate: trigger a funded act of good",
        "Fund: create capacity for more good to happen"
      ]
    },
    "right": {
      "heading": "NEXT / FUTURE",
      "bullets": [
        "Express (next): acknowledge someone who made a difference",
        "Facilitate (future): help deliver good in the real world"
      ]
    },
    "notes": "Jo-approved slide 3 copy. Never present Express or Facilitate as available today."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "Every action strengthens the network.",
    "body": "Millions of actions create the infrastructure for human acknowledgment.",
    "bullets": [
      "Funding creates capacity",
      "Capacity is activated by a real person",
      "A trusted partner delivers it",
      "Delivery is verified, not assumed",
      "Verification builds trust",
      "Trust brings more funders, activators, and partners"
    ],
    "notes": "Jo-approved flywheel language, 9/15/26. Do not use 'every message builds the network,' that line is retired."
  },
  {
    "type": "stats",
    "title": "We're connecting existing capital, not creating a new market",
    "stats": [
      {"value": "$100B+", "label": "Corporate wellbeing and engagement spend today"},
      {"value": "$240B", "label": "Projected wellbeing market by 2035"},
      {"value": "$2.3T+", "label": "Global charitable giving, annual"},
      {"value": "$2.4T+", "label": "Combined addressable market"}
    ],
    "notes": "Sources: Grand View Research / Precedence Research for wellbeing; State of Global Charitable Giving report for philanthropy. The budgets already exist, we help direct them."
  },
  {
    "type": "two-column",
    "title": "Two entities. One system.",
    "left": {
      "heading": "Gratitude.com, Inc.",
      "bullets": [
        "Delaware C-Corp, B Corp pending",
        "Makes participation possible",
        "Builds the platform: product, enterprise, revenue, scale"
      ]
    },
    "right": {
      "heading": "ActivateGratitude.org",
      "bullets": [
        "The charitable entity behind delivery",
        "501(c)(3) determination [NEEDS INPUT]",
        "Makes the impact possible: funding, partners, verification"
      ]
    },
    "notes": "Never state B Corp as certified, it is pending. Never state 501(c)(3) as granted, status is unconfirmed."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "The market is fragmented. We build the connecting layer.",
    "body": "Recognition, giving, and wellbeing are solved separately today. No one connects them into one system of action.",
    "bullets": [
      "Recognition: Workhuman, Achievers, Microsoft Viva Glint",
      "Giving: Benevity, Blackbaud (YourCause), Deed",
      "Wellbeing: Modern Health, Lyra Health, Headspace Health"
    ],
    "notes": "Describe our moat as the dual commercial and charitable entity structure. Do not cite 501(c)(3) as part of the moat, status is unconfirmed."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "This round proves the model. The next scales it.",
    "body": "A 24-month path from launch to category leadership.",
    "bullets": [
      "Launch (60-90 days): Activate + Fund MVP live, first enterprise customers, first nonprofit partners",
      "Validate (months 1-6): thousands of verified activations, demonstrated enterprise value, a proven repeatable model",
      "Scale (18-24 months): millions of participants, a global nonprofit ecosystem, category leadership"
    ],
    "notes": "No projected user counts beyond 'thousands' and 'millions' as directional milestones, not commitments."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "Strategic acquisition, not a bet on an IPO",
    "body": "These are comparable transactions, not projections.",
    "bullets": [
      "2018: SAP acquires Qualtrics, $8B",
      "2020: HG Capital acquires Benevity, $1.1B",
      "2021: Clearlake takes Cornerstone private, $5.2B",
      "2023: Silver Lake / CPP take Qualtrics private, $12.5B"
    ],
    "notes": "State clearly these are comps, not IRR or return projections."
  },
  {
    "type": "content",
    "title": "The round",
    "body": "A Friends & Family SAFE, with an optional gift alongside it.",
    "bullets": [
      "SAFE: $3-5M, $20M post-money cap, no discount",
      "Investment amount is the investor's choice, converts at the cap in a future priced round",
      "A SAFE earns no return until it converts. No projected returns or IRR",
      "Optional gift to ActivateGratitude.org, investor's choice, no equity attached, tax treatment [NEEDS INPUT]",
      "Use of funds: 60% product & engineering, 20% growth & partnerships, 10% operations, 10% partner network"
    ],
    "notes": "Do not state committed amounts or name investors. Use-of-funds percentages carried from prior deck, confirm against current deck before this goes external."
  },
  {
    "type": "closing",
    "title": "Imagine if good intention always had somewhere to go.",
    "subtitle": "gratitude.com",
    "body": "One action becomes impact. Impact builds trust. Trust inspires another action. We're building the infrastructure. Join the round.",
    "notes": "Close with the founder's contact: Michael Hilf, Founder & CEO, mhilf@gratitude.com."
  }
]
```

This deck sticks strictly to verified facts: the SAFE terms, entity structure, approved flywheel copy, and the two approved problem stats. Traction numbers, team slides, and committed capital are intentionally left out since those are marked [NEEDS INPUT] in the current brand kit.

You can download this as a branded PowerPoint or PDF. If you have real traction numbers, a team slide, or updated use-of-funds percentages to drop in, send them over and I'll fold them in.
